name: International Relations
notes: At least 12 courses, minimum 2.0 GPA; at least 9 of 12 listed as INTR or PSCI; no S/F courses. Requirements apply to the Class of 2021 and later.
STUDY ABROAD REQUIRED: a semester in an organized education-abroad program (waived for students who lived outside the US for 2+ of the 4 years before matriculation) - not auto-checked.

LANGUAGE REQUIRED: two college-level courses taught in a modern spoken language other than English, IN ADDITION to the 12 major courses; both intro courses must be the same language; AP may not satisfy it; language courses may double-count with a humanities cluster - not auto-checked.
Tools courses cannot double-count toward core track, breadth, or electives.
Transfer: none for tools or writing; max two toward the core track; max three total; no online courses.
AP Government/History or IB Global Politics/History HL grants four credits (elective + introductory + transfer).

requirementGroups.label: Tools of political analysis (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Tools of Political Analysis (Two Courses): PSCI 107; PSCI 200; PSCI 202W; PSCI 203W; PSCI 205; PSCI 281; PSCI 288

requirementGroups.label: Core track (5 courses from one field)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Core Track (Five Courses from One Track): Governance of Nations; Peace and Conflict; Politics, Policy, and Development

requirementGroups.label: Breadth (2 courses outside your core track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Select two track courses that are not in your core track.

requirementGroups.label: Electives (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Courses may be drawn from any offerings in the three tracks or any other courses in INTR, PSCI, ECON, or HIST.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two W-designated courses
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: Select any two W-designated courses. Included in the 12 courses listed above. No more than one of these courses may be used to satisfy the writing requirement in a second or third major.
